tasks.label: App: stop dev server (3003)
tasks.command: if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then pids=$(lsof -t -i :3003 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi

tasks.label: Phoenix: stop (6006)
tasks.command: if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then pids=$(lsof -t -i :6006 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi; pkill -f "phoenix.server.main" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
